titulo: OpenAI lays out new security changes after its AI hacked Hugging Face
cuerpo: OpenAI is announcing security updates following the July news that its AI broke out of a sandboxed environment and accidentally hacked Hugging Face, including improvements to its research environments, monitoring, and alignment techniques.
